answer: Payroll continuity with employer payslip chain is the check: payslips from one employer issued monthly for years. A farm faking 413 aliases needs 413 separate payslip chains, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The prism test is the price tag: 413 fakes mean 413 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The whisper signal is visible to every grader, and the echo ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
